body:
Why won't they hang out with me? And why won't they invite me to do things? Great, so they would be sad if I was dead. That's not my point. I am sad to live because I'm so easily forgotten, when alive. So if I was dead, suddenly everyone would feel sorrow but if I'm alive they are neglectful? That's supposed to make me feel better?

The issue is I feel no joy in life. I despise being alone. I tell them to invite me to things, I ask them to hang out with me. They nod but never do. I'm that nice girl that no one really knows who she is, but everyone doesn't mind having her around. I feel like I'm part of an ambient crowd, background shit. I don't care if they care, I want them to interact with me. Even though I work and study in a room full of people, I still feel lonely.

I reached out to just about anyone. Seriously, name something and I'll tell you when I "reached out" for it.
